reviews.title: Waste of money. Complete scam
reviews.text: Spent 10s of dollars buying music with the extra pdf option only for the download pdf function to always fail. Wasted a bunch of money on a feature that doesnt even work. The app was coded by 3 year olds. Do yourself a favor and just screen shot and create a pdf. Dont be a fool and waste your money.

reviews.title: BOOOOOOO!
reviews.text: Frustrating. My purchase was right there in the my library but it “couldn’t find it” to print.The AI chat help was useless and, frustratingly, asked for name, email, and order number repeatedly. Finally got referred to an “agent”. Haven’t heard back

reviews.title: 6 dollars wasted
reviews.text: I spent 6 dollars on sheet music and it didn’t allow me to view it.

reviews.title: Subpar and no clear way to cancel
reviews.text: The app might work OK if you try to do everything on a single device, but the reason I subscribed to this so I could sync my music across different device devices. This is kind of pointless because you have to re-download your music on every device. To make things worse, there’s no clear way to cancel your membership. I finally found it buried and hidden after looking at all their support documentation which was of no help and trying to contact their support which wasn’t open.  Also, the markup functionality really sucks. There’s no undo button so anytime you want to undo something You have to select the eraser make it really big, erase, then go back and select the pen and make that small again. And by the way, there’s no way to make the pen the right size. you have to just try your hardest to get the slider in the right spot and then if it’s not the right size you have to go through the entire erase process again.

reviews.title: meh
reviews.text: The fact that I have to pay like 4+ bucks for ONE song that I don't even know is good quality is kinda dookie, but being able to play the sheet music is a sweet feature and the only time I can get sheet music is in highschool during the school years cuz its through this one teacher who has like literally every musical theatre sheet music known to man

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Only lets you print the cover sheet after purchase. Be sure to use your credit card and not Apple Pay so you can get your money back.

reviews.title: Terrible app for flute
reviews.text: Awkward filtering to find flute music.  Limited choices.  While trialing the app, trying to use a Bluetooth foot pedal on the free version was complete frustration.  Hit the pedal, and “sign up for Pro!” Pops up every time instead of a second page.

reviews.title: App is Completely Useless
reviews.text: I am paying a lot of money for the Pro Premium version and I can’t even access my music library in the app. Literally, nothing is there. Completely useless.

reviews.title: Pen function needs fixed
reviews.text: As a pianist I have to be able mark my music without it jerking and scribbling all over the page.

reviews.title: Pedal randomly stopped working with app during a performance and hasn't worked since
reviews.text: I was using my pedal to turn pages in MusicNotes for literal years when one day, it randomly stopped working.  I followed all of the suggestions on their website, and it actually messed up the keyboard settings for my iPad in general.  I'm not sure if it's the latest update, or maybe a strategy to get more people to purchase PDFs instead of reading from the app, but this issue has severely detrimented several of my professional performances already. I would definitely avoid this app until they have the pedal issue comletely resolved.

reviews.title: Major Systems Issues - No Correction 2+ Years!
reviews.text:
Musicians who need a reliable app for performances; DO NOT USE THIS APP! I’m stuck with this app bc of the amount of music I have purchased in the many years I’ve had it. It shuts down MULTIPLE times during performances, closes the app out entirely in the middle of songs, freezes during searches, only lets me upload one song at a time for set list creations, and so on. I have tried tech support, I have updated my iPad, archived songs as suggested, and still nothing. I told tech support this and crickets. They offered me no further suggestions, no fixes. 

So what do I do? Improv. I’ve learned to improv with one hand while reopening the app and finding the song with the other. I don’t recommend it, it’s stressful when you’re in the middle of, say, a wedding processional. 

Do not use this app if you will want a large library, if you’ll want to import .pdfs, or if you want reliability. It’s been garbage for me for 2+ years but I’m too financial invested in the music purchased at this point to stop using it. So learn from me: try something else.

reviews.title: Awful.
reviews.text: This app is not good on the iPhone. Any music I bought is so small on the screen you can’t see it if it’s in portrait position, landscape is easier to see but doesn’t run smooth , flickers and judders all over the place making it impossible to follow. It’s pretty rubbish which won’t encourage me to buy more or pay for the app which I think is the point.

reviews.title: AI customer service, NOT
reviews.text: I make an error on my order. This was because the website would not allow me to review my order. What I received were item I did nothing t request. I attempted to work with their AI chat with New success. Stop with the AI chat until it is more versed in communication. I am done with this app.

reviews.title: Servers are down
reviews.text: Trying to login for 1h. Clicked forgot password - nothing happens. And later I got 14 emails. Service is down. Ironically they push users to have all sheets in the app. And when it is not working you don’t have access to them. 1 star. Probably they fired all devs and hired vibecoders

reviews.title: Amazing app, and then….
reviews.text: This has been a great app. I’ve loved it. And now suddenly, the app prevents me from viewing any sheet music in the shop. I updated the app, to make sure, and it did not solve the problem.

reviews.title: New update broke the sign in
reviews.text: I updated the app and I can no longer sign in to my account. It just keeps attempting to load the account and I have left it actively trying to sign in for 5 minutes

reviews.title: Why are only certain keys available?
reviews.text:
Absolutely absurd that songs can be transposed, but not to any key. Why?? Ridiculous. Seems like every time I or a student wants a song in a different key, it happens to be one of the few keys that is not available.

Also a lot of these songs have lots of typos. They should give refunds for typos. Really sloppy, non-consumer friendly service.

reviews.title: Apple pen does not work with notations
reviews.text: Notations

reviews.title: Not very flexible
reviews.text:
I have 2 major issues with this music. 
One is that you have to buy the music before you can see if it can be transposed. I tried both the app and the website with no luck. Playing a song in Gb isn’t my best key; I can play it in G, but what if it’s too high for the singers? I buy the music and then have to manually transpose? I don’t have 3 weeks to wait on it to be done. 
Second, I have a bad printer, so I download music to a flash drive and take it to the library to print. This app will not allow me to print from the download.  I don’t want to make multiple copies- just the one I’m entitled to. 
Not all of us have yet invested in a big tablet and digital music app; if you have, you are in a bit better position.

This is nothing like another site I use and prefer, which gives previews showing the available keys, and allows me to download and print it in different keys. I’m really disappointed with this site  and will only use it as a last resort.

reviews.title: Music notes used to be great
reviews.text: The new version of Musicnotes crashes all the time right in the middle of a CERT. You have to completely reboot and then find your place again and that is made it completely unusable I am trying to find something else at this point because it’s just not a good app anymore

reviews.title: Not accurate sheet music
reviews.text: I am learning a song on the piano for my band and I needed the sheet music to dial-in the piano solo. I decided to spend five dollars and buy the song. What I got was a simplified improvised version of the song where the left hand is doing the boogie Woogie and the right hand is actually playing the melody of the vocals. This is not at all how the piano goes in this song and the piano solo was left out entirely. The app seems to work good but the quality of the product in the app is not good at all.

reviews.title: Sheet Music Copies
reviews.text: Once I have paid for my sheet music and printed it out, there was another charge again if I needed to reprint it in the future!  I don’t agree with that at all.  Sheet music off of regular printer paper can easily become damaged and lost.  There should never be another charge.  Especially because it’s digital.  I’m not requiring a company to mail out a new copy.

reviews.title: Worst App
reviews.text: This app is terrible. It gives so many errors. It doesn’t even allow you to view a simple PDF of music that you bought. I would not recommend this app or the services at all.

reviews.title: They lost my account
reviews.text: I was a subscriber to Musicnotes pro for 6 years, and my pro subscription is expiring only in August of this year. But it looks like Musicnotes simply lost my account. I was  trying to connect to the customer service, and send them all the documents I have confirming that I was a paying pro subscriber for 6 years. The only reply I got so far is that I deleted this account myself (which I did not) and basically refusing the service. I am curious if I can request a full refund (6 years in total) from the Apple Pay plus compensation for unfair commercial practice from the Musicnotes.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: You purchase the app only to have to buy the music you want to play

reviews.title: Very poor customer service; request pending since mid Dec.
reviews.text: I have a MusicNotes Pro- Premium subscription from Jan 2026 to now.  I sent a request in Dec. for an accounting of what I had used my Pro credits for, since I was showing zero balance and do not remember using them.  In the 6 weeks I’ve been waiting, the only email I received asked for evidence of my Jan 2026 subscription.  I sent a screen shot of the sub from the Apple subscription page and have not heard back.  If you believe I used them all in 2026, then it’s as simple as sending or pointing me to the list of songs purchased with those credits.  Otherwise, reinstate those credits and I will renew my subscription.  Product is great but support needs serious attention.

reviews.title: Scam, “This song is missing”
reviews.text: I purchased sheet music and when I try to open it up and says the song is missing and tells me to download it again. It then shows that same error message when I try to download it again. Nonsense app, waste of money.

reviews.title: Deceptive listing
reviews.text: Not at any point, was it advertised that this app cost $5.99. But when I downloaded it, it auto charge me without any information or indication that there was a charge to this app. Also will not play audibly the sheet music I upload. Which was the purpose of me downloading this app.

reviews.title: Does the job but is a little awkward at times.
reviews.text: I use this to read pdfs and it does the job but the UI for making set lists and importing pdfs is a little buggy. There seems to be a lag between when you add a pdf to a set list or make a set list, and when it actually saves those changes. It also takes a second for annotations to show up. Just small things like that make it useable but awkward.

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY, SCAM
reviews.text: I always have used this app, but after a recent update it changed and took money from me. I bought a song today, for 15 dollars, i tried playing it but all it let me do was scroll through the song, i had to pay and extra 3 dollars to play the actual music. Once i bought it, it would not let me use the song. I had to REBUY the song which cost another 15 dollars. The song would not load and not show up in my library. Very upsetting. The additional fee was wrong.

reviews.title: Crashes a lot lately
reviews.text: Crashes a lot, which isn’t great considering I’m attempting to play music from sheet music on the app during a concert.
